accepted_design: Full native frontmatter is projected unchanged except the host entry name. Wrappers link to canonical native files and retain original relative-reference context. New installs omit the relocated copy. Receipt/CONFIG identify the canonical dependency; verify/check-runtime revalidate it, while remove is local receipt-scoped and remains usable if the dependency is missing or changed.
pin_effect: The checked-in release/3.0.5/manifest.json and all public/frozen records stay unchanged. Scratch candidate packages will explicitly recompute only their own selected changed source rows; successor packaging remains unperformed.
requirement_drift: None selected: SK-01/02/04/10/11 and native metadata/reference semantics remain the same.
